City of Tolleson Comprehensive Annual Financial Report, Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2020
sources.notes: The report cover identifies this document as the FY2020 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2020, despite the misleading FY2019 local archive filename. Under Accomplishments and Initiatives, PDF viewer page 13 (printed page iii), the City reports that license plate readers were strategically placed throughout the city during FY2020. This establishes a City-reported deployment by the end of FY2020, but does not establish the manufacturer, device count, precise installation dates or locations, expenditure, ownership, continued operation, or current inventory. The report also describes separate police crime-mapping and resident security-video-sharing initiatives; it does not establish that either was integrated with the license plate readers.
